description:
Configures and saves a Google Tag Manager (GTM) container binding and initial Google Consent Mode v2 storage signal defaults ('ad_storage', 'analytics_storage', 'ad_user_data', 'ad_personalization') plus 'paperloo_consent_update' dataLayer trigger settings for a registered site.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'configure_gtm_integration' to store a GTM container ID and default consent states on a site; call 'get_gtm_container_setup' afterward to retrieve the rendered '<head>'/'<body>' GTM snippets reflecting those saved defaults.

Preconditions & side effects: 'siteId' must match a registered site, and 'gtm_container_id' must match '^GTM-[A-Z0-9]{4,12}$'. Mutates the site's 'gtm' object in the active registry.

Returns: JSON object with 'success: true', 'siteId', 'site_name', saved 'gtm_configuration', and 'message' (or 'success: false' and 'error').

default_ad_personalization.description: Initial GCM v2 default for personalized advertising / remarketing.

default_ad_storage.description: Initial GCM v2 default for advertising cookies before user interaction.

default_ad_user_data.description: Initial GCM v2 default for sending user data to Google for advertising.

default_analytics_storage.description: Initial GCM v2 default for analytics cookies before user interaction.

gtm_container_id.description: Google Tag Manager Container ID starting with 'GTM-' followed by 4-12 uppercase alphanumeric characters.

siteId.description: Registered site UUID or exact registered URL.

trigger_events.description: Dispatch a custom 'paperloo_consent_update' event to window.dataLayer whenever visitor consent changes.

name: configure_gtm_integration

outputSchema.description: Saved Google Tag Manager and GCM v2 configuration result.

available_sites.description: Registered sites returned when siteId does not match.

items.description: Summary entry for a registered monitored website.

error.description: Validation or site lookup error message.

gtm_configuration.description: Saved GTM container binding and consent default states.

gtm_container_id.description: Normalized Google Tag Manager container ID.

trigger_events.description: Whether consent changes emit dataLayer events.

site_name.description: Display name of the updated site.

success.description: True if GTM configuration was validated and persisted; false otherwise.

title: Configure Google Tag Manager & Consent Mode v2
